title: bug: CI never runs scripts/tests/daemon-json-cap.test.mjs or seat-registration.test.mjs (explicit node --test lists)
description: .github/workflows/ci.yml runs launcher node tests from explicit file lists (lines ~230-245, e.g. the prompt-cache-launcher step). `grep -n 'seat-registration\|daemon-json-cap' .github/workflows/*.yml` finds nothing, so both real-launcher-block suites (the daemon.json cap from task-ad0dc2e7, and the seat re-join from task-8333866a) never run in CI. Add them to an existing node --test step; Linux runs the bash leg, and the windows matrix job, if it runs them, adds PS 5.1/pwsh/Git Bash.
definitionOfDone: ci.yml runs node --test on scripts/tests/daemon-json-cap.test.mjs and scripts/tests/seat-registration.test.mjs in at least the Linux job
Both suites pass on the CI runner(s) they are added to

implementationPlan.description:
WIRE CI (DoD 1). In .github/workflows/ci.yml, job build-all-platforms (matrix ubuntu-latest, windows-latest, macos-latest), add ONE step directly after 'Test agent runtime discovery':

```yaml
      - name: Test launcher daemon.json cap and seat re-registration
        # Real launcher blocks: Linux runs bash and pwsh 7; Windows runs Git Bash,
        # PowerShell 5.1 and pwsh 7. Not macOS: its /bin/bash is 3.2 and these
        # suites have not been run there.
        if: runner.os != 'macOS'
        run: node --test scripts/tests/daemon-json-cap.test.mjs scripts/tests/seat-registration.test.mjs
```

Why a new step instead of appending to an existing node --test step: every existing one also runs on macOS.
- GitHub's ubuntu-latest and macos-latest images ship pwsh, so these suites' PowerShell 7 legs, which have only ever run on Windows, would run on Unix too.
- macOS adds /bin/bash 3.2.
- Neither can be verified before merge.

Keep the file LF, with 6-space step indentation exactly like its neighbours. Then:
- parse it: `python3 -c "import yaml,sys; d=yaml.safe_load(open('.github/workflows/ci.yml')); s=[x for x in d['jobs']['build-all-platforms']['steps'] if 'daemon-json-cap' in str(x.get('run',''))]; assert len(s)==1 and s[0]['if']==\"runner.os != 'macOS'\", s"`;
- re-run the two suites: the step-1 guards must now pass.

Contested landing: two idle, unassigned WORKING CQ rows (task-340a07b3, task-4e412148) also declare ci.yml, which was clean at plan time. Make the edit through a wrapper-observed file-editing tool call, never a shell redirect.
implementationPlan.note: Added one step after 'Test agent runtime discovery' via Edit (7 insertions, 0 deletions, LF). PyYAML parse OK: exactly one step with if == runner.os != 'macOS'. Guards now green: fail 0, pass 25, skipped 48 (no pwsh in WSL).

implementationPlan.description:
VERIFY ON EVERY ENGINE THE NEW STEP WILL RUN (DoD 2). CI cannot be triggered from here: ci.yml runs on push and PR to main only. Local runs that match each runner's engines are the evidence, so report counts per engine.

1) Linux, matching ubuntu-latest, which has bash and pwsh 7.
- WSL has no pwsh, so fetch a portable one into the scratch dir: the linux-x64 tarball from github.com/PowerShell/PowerShell/releases (any 7.x), extracted with `chmod +x`.
- Then run, from the repo root: `env -u MOE_WORKER_ID -u MOE_PROJECT_PATH -u MOE_SESSION_ID ... PATH=<pwsh dir>:$PATH node --test scripts/tests/daemon-json-cap.test.mjs scripts/tests/seat-registration.test.mjs`. Scrub every MOE_*/CLAUDE* variable.
- Required: 0 failed, and the only skips are 'PowerShell 5.1 is Windows-only'. A pwsh skip means pwsh was not found, so fix PATH.
- This pwsh-on-Linux leg has never run (both suites' authors verified Windows only), so treat its first result carefully.

2) Windows, matching windows-latest, which has Git Bash, PS 5.1 and pwsh 7.
- From WSL, run `node.exe --test` on Windows paths of a /mnt/d/moe-scratch snapshot (git archive HEAD plus this task's three files), with MOE_*/CLAUDE* unset.
- Required: 0 failed, 0 skipped.

Decision rule if a Linux pwsh case fails:
- The case asserts Windows-only behaviour: make that suite's PowerShell 7 engine skip off Windows with an explicit reason string, the pattern prompt-cache-launcher, usage-launcher and moe-account-lease use, which run only bash off Windows. Never weaken a bash or Windows assertion.
- It exposes a real ps1 defect on Unix pwsh: do not fix it here. moe.create_task a LOW bug in this epic, make the engine skip off Windows with a reason naming that task id, and say so in complete_task.

This task's complete_task verification command is leg 1's exact command, and its output tail must show the per-engine counts. Put the leg-2 counts and the YAML parse result in the summary.

planningNotes.approachesConsidered:
CHOSEN: a new build-all-platforms step limited to Linux and Windows (`if: runner.os != 'macOS'`), plus a precedent-matching self-check in each suite. The epic rail requires a regression test, and the self-check is red until the step exists.

REJECTED:
- Appending the files to 'Test agent runtime discovery', as the description suggests. That step also runs on macOS, where /bin/bash 3.2 and pwsh would run these suites unverified. A red macOS leg on main would block the fleet's PRs.
- A Linux-only step: it drops the Windows PS 5.1/pwsh/Git Bash legs, which are the suites' most valuable coverage, since ps1 is the Windows launcher.
- Making every scripts/tests/*.test.mjs required in CI: three other suites are also absent, which is out of scope.
planningNotes.codebaseInsights:
- ci.yml runs only on push and PR to main, so a moe/work push never runs it. The matrix job build-all-platforms covers ubuntu, windows and macos, and its node --test steps carry no `if`.
- Both suites pick engines the same way:
  - bash: '/bin/bash' off Windows, Git Bash 'C:/Program Files/Git/bin/bash.exe' on Windows;
  - PS 5.1: skipped off Windows;
  - pwsh 7: probed with `pwsh -Command $PSVersionTable...` and skipped only when absent.
  GitHub's Linux and macOS images include pwsh, so CI would run the PowerShell 7 legs there. Their authors never could: WSL has no pwsh. Evidence from task-8333866a and task-ad0dc2e7 shows Windows 57/57 and 14/14, WSL bash only.
- The self-check precedent is scripts/tests/local-runner-check.test.mjs:274 (a line-based read of ci.yml).
planningNotes.risks:
- The Linux pwsh leg has never run, and step 3 has the decision rule for it.
